title: Switch family
description: One product family from one vendor, with every orderable model in it. Values come from the vendor datasheet named in `source`.

role.description: Campus role. Defaults to access. Aggregation covers distribution and core fabric lines (for example Catalyst 9500, CX 8325). Browse can filter on this; the closet sizer only considers access models with copper or fiber access ports.

maxMembers.description: 1 when not stackable; null when there is no hardware stack but switches are managed as a fabric (for example FortiLink)

frontPanel.description: true when stacking consumes front uplink ports (for example Aruba VSF)

routeScale.description: As the vendor states it. Not normalized.

additionalSources.description: Further keys into data/sources.json, for vendor documents that supply values the primary source does not

verify.description: Family-level fields that still need confirming

verifyNote.description: Why the family-level fields are flagged

lifecycle.description: Family-wide lifecycle state. A model's own lifecycle overrides it

ipRating.description: Family default, for example IP30. Overridden per model

lifecycle.description: Where the product is in its sales and support life. Absent means current.

status.description: current: still orderable. endOfSale: no longer orderable but still supported. endOfSupport: past the last day of support

endOfSaleDate.description: Last day the vendor accepts orders. Required once status is endOfSale or endOfSupport

replacement.description: SKUs or family ids the vendor names as the successor. Only when the vendor names one

tempRange.description: Operating temperature range in degrees Celsius, as the datasheet states it

mounting.description: Every mounting method the datasheet lists

redundancy.description: Whether a second power supply (or built-in redundant input) is available, and how it is provided

detail.description: How redundancy is delivered: built in, included, or sold separately; internal or external

source.description: Overrides the family source when a model has its own datasheet

accessPorts.description: PoE-bearing access ports at 25G and below. Empty on pure fabric/aggregation models. One entry per group of identical ports

fabricPorts.description: High-speed ports above 25G (aggregation fabric). Never carry PoE. Empty or omitted when the model has none

uplinks.description: Key into data/uplinks.json. Omit on all-fabric switches that have no separate uplink module

poeBudgets.description: Available PoE for each power supply configuration the datasheet lists, smallest first

switchingGbps.description: null when the datasheet does not publish it

poweredBy.description: For switches that can be powered over PoE or by an adapter

ruggedized.description: Built for extended temperature, dust, or vibration. Overrides the family value

ipRating.description: Overrides the family value, for example IP30

accessoryPart.description: One optic, DAC/AOC, or stacking cable. Values come from the vendor source on the parent catalog file.

speedGbps.description: 1, 10, 20, 25, 40, 50, 100, 120, or 400. Null for stack-fabric cables and kits with no rated data rate.

reach.description: Required on transceivers. Omit on DAC, AOC, and stacking. Values follow the vendor's own reach labels.

distanceM.description: Reach in metres. 0 for kits. Fractional values allowed (for example 0.5 or 0.65).

verified.description: true when the SKU is traced to a vendor datasheet or matrix. false when it still needs confirming. Unverified parts stay in Accessories listings without a check tag, and appear on the Needs checking page.

appliesTo.description: Optional family IDs this part applies to. Absent means every family of that vendor (typical for optics/DACs/AOCs). Present means only those families (typical for stacking cables/kits). An empty array means the part stays in the vendor catalog but appears on no switch detail view.

accessoryCatalog.description: Per-vendor accessory shortlist. The full matrix stays behind opticsMatrixUrl.

opticsMatrixUrl.description: Vendor optics compatibility or transceiver guide
